key_insight: topas-editor and TOPilot connect generative AI with TOPAS to automate crystallographic analysis of diffraction and total scattering data.
engineering_relevance: These freely available tools can streamline structure characterization workflows, from phase identification and structure solution to refinement and pair distribution function fitting.
method: Use a TOPAS-aware VS Code extension for input editing, syntax guidance and reference access.
Equip AI with Python routines, machine-accessible documentation and a transferable topas-inp-writer skill.
Run workflows through the editor, a standalone wizard, command-line interfaces or AI desktop apps.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations spanning complex Rietveld refinement, multiple-data-set analysis, indexing-to-refinement workflows, phase identification, incommensurate structures and PDF fitting, but provides no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Development and testing used Claude models; reliability with other cloud or local models requires validation.
paper_title: topas-editor and TOPilot: tools for AI-driven analysis of diffraction and total scattering data
